script.title: Blog itna slow kyun hai?

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Blog ka home page bahut slow load ho raha tha. Chalo dekhte hain request kahan kahan jaati hai.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Django view saare posts laata hai, aur har post ke saath uske author ka naam dikhata hai.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: ORM yeh sab PostgreSQL se SQL queries chala ke laata hai.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Ab socho. Sau posts hain, aur template har post ke liye post dot author padhta hai. Kitni queries chalengi?

pause.prompt: 100 posts, and the template reads post.author for each one. How many SQL queries run?
choices: 101: one for posts, one per author

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Ek sau ek. Ek query posts ke liye, phir har author ke liye alag. Isse N plus one problem kehte hain.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Fix hai select related author. ORM ek hi JOIN query mein posts aur authors dono le aata hai.

script.takeaway: Load related rows in the same query (select_related) instead of one query per row.

questions.prompt: Why did the blog page run 101 queries?
choices: Each post's author was loaded with its own query
questions.explanation: Reading post.author lazily runs one query per post; select_related joins them into one.
